disposition.change: Set the valid-from of RES-2026.12 to one date reconciled with RWB-E2-035 (2026-12-01 or 11 December 2026) before the wave-2 fixture freeze.
disposition.note: Story fixtures keep the legacy 11 December 2026 reading; the registry date is reconciled in RWB-P7-E2042-APP.

disposition.change: Specify the rule-catalog answer (packageCode, packageVersion, versionState, inForce, ruleId, ruleVersion, actionText, ownerRole, timerSpec, toState, droolsRuleName, outputs) and the latest-state-change answer (entryId, ruleId, ruleVersion, decidedAt, missing); add 404 and 422 for MSG-P3-027 and MSG-GEN-001.
disposition.note: Answer schemas belong to the rwb-decision contract and catalogue; this story only consumes them.

disposition.change: Add a Case record column for every role, publish the 14-area matrix as data through RWB-P4-AD002-APP, and fix the default scope of the specialist roles with the security administrator before PM-2026.12 is in force.
disposition.note: Case record letters and specialist default scope are data; ASM-3865 stays open until they are published.

disposition.change: Add GET /api/recovery/access/v1/role-catalogue/{roleCode} with its answer schema, publish it with RWB-P4-E1037-CON and stub it in the contract fake; fix the authorise request and answer; fix the rwb-access login in the platform DB story; add the unknown or inactive role code message.
disposition.note: The operation, authorise shapes, login name and unknown-role message are owned by the contract and appendix; section 3 keeps the gap reference.

disposition.change: Agree with QA at the wave 2 entry check: composite route path, merge order, call list, slow-source answer, harness repository, SIT environment, seeded data, evidence format and retention, and pass/fail gate.
disposition.note: No source gives these values; the integration lead and platform edge agree them, and the case service keeps the route story.

disposition.note: Five values kept as data or defaults; legacy criteria stay proved by RWB-ITG-E2035-ITG, and this story writes its own criteria.

disposition.change: Add CUSTOMER_PARTY to LOV-ROLE-CLASS in the same load that carries the roles, let customer-party roles carry it, and confirm the value with the role catalogue owner before the wave-2 policy pack goes in force.
